reason: The hypothesis combines the separate findings that HPT creates pinning defects (P1) and that low-temperature annealing induces nanoscale phase decomposition (P7) with the conflicting observation that HPT can dissolve precipitates (P11) into a novel cyclic processing route. This integration of deformation and annealing cycles to retain precipitates while maintaining defect density is not proposed in any passage, and the specific cyclic HPT/annealing protocol for CoCrFeNiGa0.5 is untested.
